class.name: RenderGpuOcclusionContext
class.brief_description: Temporary native view and compute scope for the experimental current-frame GPU occlusion prepass.
class.description: Supplied only to the synchronous producer configured by [method RenderingServer.viewport_configure_gpu_occlusion_prepass]. Do not instantiate it from a script or retain its borrowed depth/list for later use. Context getters return unavailable defaults after callback return. CPU completion is not a GPU fence. The engine owns depth and the compute list. Record only supported checked compute work against private hierarchy/scratch, registered candidate identities and candidate commands. Do not mutate scene objects, fallback data or current pose state; do not free resources, read back, submit/synchronize, begin/end lists, draw or schedule asynchronous continuations. This experimental capability is limited to its documented opaque Windows x64 Vulkan Forward+ single-view configuration. The context supplies recording identity and actual view data; it does not validate conservative culling algorithms or GPU command contents.

method.name: get_camera_transform
method.description: Returns the current native camera transform, or identity when inactive.

method.name: get_compute_list
method.description: Returns the engine-owned compute-list token for checked compute recording, or [code]-1[/code] when inactive. Only the engine may end this list.

method.name: get_configuration_generation
method.description: Returns the current nonreused configuration generation. Echo this exact integer in the producer acknowledgment. Returns zero when inactive.

method.name: get_depth
method.description: Returns borrowed read-only sampled current-frame native depth for the whole internal extent. Reverse-Z clear depth is zero. The same native image resumes as the remaining depth attachment after recording. Do not free, write, retain or apply a second depth correction to it. Returns an invalid RID when inactive.

method.name: get_epoch
method.description: Returns this viewport's actual render-recording epoch. Skipped renders do not advance it; simulation ticks and other viewports are independent. Echo this exact integer in the acknowledgment. Returns zero when inactive.

method.name: get_internal_size
method.description: Returns the current full internal render extent, or zero when inactive. Partial render regions are unsupported.

method.name: get_projection
method.description: Returns the actual corrected native projection, including Godot depth/Y correction, for the admitted orthographic or centered perspective view. Do not apply those corrections again or use near/far extraction formulas that assume an uncorrected projection. Perspective culling must conservatively handle the full projected bound and near-plane or nonpositive clip-W uncertainty. Returns identity when inactive. TAA and motion-vector demand remain outside this scope.

method.name: get_view_index
method.description: Returns zero for the supported single view, or [code]-1[/code] when inactive.

method.name: get_viewport
method.description: Returns the current viewport RID, or an invalid RID when inactive.

method.name: is_active
method.description: Returns whether the synchronous producer callback may still use the context. This is a CPU lifetime check, not GPU completion.
